scope: MetroPT3 T/D, fixed individual DLinear, development-only

entries.finding: A historical source-half representation reused by an autonomous Sol high agent yields a candidate that improves three-seed mean NMSE versus unprocessed B0 by 3.940884%, with mean NMAE improving 0.361558%.
entries.qualification: This validates the combined candidate against B0 on reused development data, not autonomous rediscovery, independent transfer or causal feedback benefit.

entries.finding: Changing the source coefficient signs for TP2 and DV_eletric from +0.5 to -0.5 produces 0.384154% worse global and 13.109430% worse preregistered local NMSE than the all-positive control. Every confirmation seed has the same direction.
entries.qualification: Do not turn this into a ban on sign processing in other settings. The tested sign choice and frozen training procedure failed their incremental criterion; correlations alone did not predict processing benefit.

entries.finding: An enumerated temporary output can disappear during atomic rename and trigger NATIVE_OUTPUT_TYPE. A single lstat snapshot that skips FileNotFoundError passes seven regression tests while preserving output boundaries.
entries.qualification: Original failure lacks event-level tracing; do not retroactively label every historical NATIVE_OUTPUT_TYPE as this race. One new recovery job replaced only the missing control in the confirmation summary.
